name: Glitter Dissolve
description: The picture becomes a shimmering field of tiny diamond sequins that flip over in 3D at random moments, each lifting and tilting on its own axis and flashing a glint of light, and land on the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: tiles
params.description: Number of tiles stacked across the height of the frame

params.name: sparkle
params.description: Strength of the glints the tiles catch as they turn

params.name: glint
params.description: Color of the glints, added as light

params.name: seed
params.description: Changes the order and the axes of the flips (whole numbers)

params.name: back_color
params.description: Color seen behind a tile while it is edge-on
